title: SoundGraph patch bank
description: An ordered list of patches for a board's card. Entry order is MIDI Program Change order: program 0 is the first entry, and the first entry is what the board boots into. Patch paths are relative to the bank file or absolute.

name.description: What the set is called; a label, not an identifier.

target.description: The board family the bank is baked for. Only "axoloti" today.

name.description: The entry's directory on the card, unique within the bank: letters, digits, - and _.

patch.description: The patch file, relative to the bank file or absolute.

controller.description: Which controller the set's knobs and pads are numbered for. A note, not a rule.

program_change.description: How the board answers a MIDI Program Change. midi: the entry the program number names. prev-next: program 0 is the previous entry, 1 the next, 2 the first, and every other number the entry it names, for a controller with eight program pads and a bank longer than that.

navigation_notes.description: MIDI notes that walk the bank on the board: note-on of a `previous` note loads the entry before this one, a `next` note the one after, wrapping at the ends. The patches never hear these notes. For a controller whose pads are the only buttons; a side lists several notes when the pads send other numbers on their other bank.

notes.description: A MIDI note, or a short list of them.
